name: Darn Talongrip
summary: Near Malaka'jin, Darn Talongrip watches the Stonetalon frontier. The orc scout tracks threats in the crags and carries word between forward outposts and Horde commanders.

sections.title: Frontier Scout of Stonetalon
sections.body: Darn Talongrip watches the rugged climbs into Stonetalon from the southern Barrens. At Malaka'jin, he directs recruits toward the Horde's new fronts in Ashenvale. Travelers climbing into the contested peaks can reach the Horde through his post.

sections.title: Eyes for the Command
sections.body: From Malaka'jin, Darn sends messages and reports from the front to commanders such as Kadrak, at the watch tower in the northern Barrens. Encampments scattered through the mountains face constant pressure, and Darn keeps the Horde vanguard informed as a sentry and courier.

faq.answer: Darn Talongrip scouts for the Horde from Malaka'jin in the southern Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: Where can Darn Talongrip be found?
faq.answer: Darn Talongrip can be found in the troll settlement of Malaka'jin, in the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: What is his role in Stonetalon?
faq.answer: Darn directs recruits to Kadrak in the northern Barrens to help defend the Horde's outposts in Ashenvale.

faq.q: Who is Kadrak, and why does Darn send travelers to him?
faq.answer: Kadrak commands the Horde from the watch tower in the northern Barrens and leads its Ashenvale campaign. Darn sends recruits to him to help defend the Horde's new fronts in Ashenvale.

angles.text: Darn Talongrip watches the ascent into Stonetalon and gives Horde adventurers fresh from the Barrens a point of contact.
As an orc, you know the harsh frontier where Darn keeps watch among jagged rocks and hostile wildlife.
